adr-record.title: Maintainer-Owned Repository Location
adr-record.summary: Maintainer-owned repositories use /Users/skh/ws/git/github/sindoc/<repo_name> as the canonical local workspace location.

rationale.point: One canonical path simplifies Singine automation and workspace references.
One canonical path simplifies SilkPage publication and XML payload generation.
One canonical path simplifies Logseq, Emacs, and Collibra import references.
